package.name: a6g_gz_go2_shim
package.description: ROS nodes reproducing the real Go2 dock interfaces around the Gazebo go2_proxy (SPEC A1 7.2): cmd_vel_to_sport_sim, sport_api_sim, odom_to_tf, cloud_to_scan, plus the simulation-only leg_odom_sim (leg odometry with drift) and cloud_deskew_sim (cloud in the odom frame).
